mapper.select: SELECT id, room_id, need_approval, advance_days, max_duration_minutes, cancel_deadline_minutes, buffer_minutes, allow_recurring, created_at, updated_at FROM room_strategy WHERE room_id = #{roomId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO room_strategy (room_id, need_approval, advance_days, max_duration_minutes, cancel_deadline_minutes, buffer_minutes, allow_recurring) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{needApproval}, #{advanceDays}, #{maxDurationMinutes}, #{cancelDeadlineMinutes}, #{bufferMinutes}, #{allowRecurring})

INSERT INTO room_strategy (room_id, need_approval, advance_days, max_duration_minutes, cancel_deadline_minutes, buffer_minutes, allow_recurring) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{needApproval}, #{advanceDays}, #{maxDurationMinutes}, #{cancelDeadlineMinutes}, #{bufferMinutes}, #{allowRecurring}) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE need_approval = new.need_approval, advance_days = new.advance_days, max_duration_minutes = new.max_duration_minutes, cancel_deadline_minutes = new.cancel_deadline_minutes, buffer_minutes = new.buffer_minutes, allow_recurring = new.allow_recurring
